// OFFICE PRODUCTIVITY UTILITIES

> PRIVACY AUDITING

MATCHING RECORDS: 5

  • ToS;DR (Terms of Service; Didn't Read):
    Open-source, community-driven project rating and summarizing website terms of service and privacy policies into transparent, graded highlights.
  • Blacklight:
    Web inspection tool by The Markup that reveals specific ad trackers, third-party cookies, and user recording scripts operating on any domain.
  • Cover Your Tracks (EFF):
    Open-access privacy testing tool by the EFF that audits browser configurations, ad-blockers, and anti-fingerprinting defenses to diagnose tracking exposure.
  • Just Delete Me:
    Digital privacy directory providing direct, deep links to account-deletion pages for hundreds of web services, categorized by removal difficulty.
  • Webkay:
    An open-source, client-side browser diagnostic tool created by Robin Linus that instantly demonstrates all environment data, location estimates, software specs, and hardware fingerprints exposed by your browser.
